names.note: His own name, read out of doxologia.ro's line for 10 iunie, «Sfinții Cuvioși Teofan și Pansemnia din Antiohia», which names two people.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Ιουνίου, «Όσιοι Θεοφάνης και Πανσέμνη», with the rank word left off.

The name as name page 2252 gives it, with the grade taken off. Measured with the gate's own fold before it was written: 'антиохиискии феофан' has no other holder; the «Ефрем Антиохийский» this wave wrote two days earlier is a different forename and a different key.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 июня ст. ст. — «Прп. Феофана Антиохийского (369).»

attestations.note: The day's eighth entry. The Romanian and Greek rows already stand on this same 10 June. Name page 2252 heads him «Феофан Антиохийский, прп.» and gives «День памяти: 10 июня» and no other day. **The year 369 is the first year any calendar has given this folder**: its `dates` are null, because neither the Romanian nor the Greek page gave a year. It was NOT written into `dates` from a day line alone while the /Life/ page that would corroborate it was left unread, and it is recorded here and in the life instead; that is a question for the author. The day page prints no hymn under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 iunie — «Sfinții Cuvioși Teofan și Pansemnia din Antiohia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιοι Θεοφάνης και Πανσέμνη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and gives no years. It is plainly the same man: the Antiochene of idolatrous parents who married at fifteen, lost his wife after three years, was catechised and baptised and withdrew to a small cell, and then won the harlot Pansemne to Christ and lived beside her in a neighbouring cell, following her in death after a few weeks. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Ὁσίως βιώσαντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τὴν ἰσχύν, ἐχθροῦ ἐταπείνωσαν ὁ Θεοφάνης ὁμοῦ, Πανσέμνη ἡ πάνσεμνος, ὅθεν τῆς οὐρανίου, βασιλείας τυχόντες, ἄπαυστον ἱκεσίαν τῷ Θεῷ ἐκτελοῦσι, ὑπὲρ τῶν ἐπιτελούντων αὐτῶν, μνήμην τὴν εὔσημον.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος δ΄, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the second of two apolytikia on the page of «Όσιοι Θεοφάνης και Πανσέμνη», and the one that names them both; the first names Pansemne alone

english.text: Living in holiness upon the earth, Theophanes together with Pansemne the all-modest brought low the strength of the enemy; and so, having attained the heavenly kingdom, they offer unceasing supplication to God for those who keep their notable memory.

hymns.text: Τὴν τῶν Ὁσίων ξυνωρίδα εὐφημήσωμεν, τὸν Θεοφάνην, ἀσκητῶν τὸ ἐγκαλλώπισμα, καὶ Πανσέμνην μετανοίας εὔοσμον μῦρον, ἣν ὁ Ὅσιος τὸν Κύριον μιμούμενος, ἐκ βυθοῦ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ἀνελκύσατο, ἀνακράζοντες· Παμμακάριστοι χαίρετε.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ΄, Τῇ Ὑπερμάχῳ — the one kontakion on the page of «Όσιοι Θεοφάνης και Πανσέμνη», and it names them both

english.text: Let us praise the pair of the venerable ones — Theophanes, the adornment of ascetics, and Pansemne, the sweet-scented myrrh of repentance, whom the venerable man, in imitation of the Lord, drew up out of the deep of sin — and let us cry aloud: Rejoice, all-blessed ones.
